description.value: The chemist becomes bitter in flavor. Any creature that hits the bitter chemist with a bite attack gains the sickened condition for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half the chemist's level + his Constitution modifier). Any creature that swallows the chemist whole gains the nauseated condition for 1 round unless it succeeds at a Fortitude save (same DC as above). If the chemist is trapped in the creature's gullet and it becomes nauseated, the creature vomits him back out immediately as a free action at the start of the creature's turn; the chemist lands prone adjacent to the creature
